pos.search_hint: Search reference, customer, phone, product or SKU
pos.rules_text: With conditions: a customer phone longer than 6 characters is required. Sell earns 0.25 per item after each seller reaches 50 items (part-time) or 100 (full-time) across the selected report period. Only phone-qualified Sell items count toward that threshold. Material earns 0.25 per invoice of at least 10. Iron and Repair earn 0.20 per invoice. Buy In earns no commission. Without conditions skips phone, quantity and minimum-amount checks but keeps the service rates. This report preview does not change saved invoice commissions.

home_attendance.late_formula_explanation: Total late − excused late = late to deduct. Excused lateness follows admin rules, including pending or review requests. Time leave without a late arrival is not subtracted.
home_attendance.explanation: Progress counts qualifying workdays completed toward the full month. The target follows admin attendance settings. Deductions use the admin monthly report minute rule, including excused lateness and warning thresholds. These are previews; final payroll is confirmed by your administrator.
